name: Exp_ColorSchaffRVITrendCycle
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffRVITrendCycle custom indicator, which combines fast and slow RVI (Relative Vigor Index) with a cycle-based trend detection algorithm. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum (color buffer >5 crossing from neutral) and sell positions on bearish momentum (color buffer <2 crossing from neutral), with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffRVITrendCycle自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了快慢RVI（相对活力指数）和周期性趋势检测算法。当指标发出看涨动量信号时开多仓，发出看跌动量信号时开空仓，并可配置止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Schaff RVI趋势周期指标，该指标将快速RVI（周期23）和慢速RVI（周期50）通过周期性循环算法（周期10）融合，产生趋势方向信号。入场条件为：当指标颜色缓冲区值大于5且前一值小于6时开多仓，当颜色缓冲区值小于2且前一值大于1时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），同时支持反向信号平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额比例、基于可用保证金比例等方式。资金管理通过MarginMode枚举实现灵活配置，默认使用固定手数模式。策略采用新K线判断机制避免重复信号，但在信号触发后仅在特定条件下重新计算，可能导致信号延迟。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the Schaff RVI Trend Cycle indicator, which fuses a fast RVI (period 23) and a slow RVI (period 50) through a cyclical algorithm (cycle period 10) to generate trend direction signals. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the indicator color buffer value exceeds 5 and the previous value was below 6, while a sell position opens when the color buffer value drops below 2 and the previous value was above 1. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) levels, with optional closing on opposing signals via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters. Position sizing supports multiple modes including fixed lot, balance-based, free margin-based, and loss-adjusted margin calculations. Money management is flexibly configured through the MarginMode enum, defaulting to fixed lot mode (LOT). The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate signals, but recalculates only under specific conditions which may introduce signal latency.

pros: 采用双周期RVI融合循环算法，能有效捕捉趋势转换点，减少虚假信号
提供灵活的资金管理模式，支持固定手数、余额比例、保证金比例等多种方式
止损止盈配置完善，默认2:1的盈亏比有利于长期正期望值
新K线判断机制避免同一根K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易
可独立控制多空方向的开仓和平仓，策略配置灵活度高
pros_en: Dual-period RVI with cycle fusion algorithm effectively captures trend reversal points and reduces false signals
Flexible money management supporting fixed lot, balance-based, margin-based and other sizing modes
Well-configured stop loss and take profit with a default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio favoring long-term positive expectancy
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Independent control over buy/sell opening and closing provides high configuration flexibility
cons: 依赖自定义指标ColorSchaffRVITrendCycle，该指标必须单独安装且不在标准库中，增加了部署复杂度
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值偏大，在小周期或高波动品种上可能不合适
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在流动性差或点差大的时段可能产生不利成交
指标颜色缓冲区的魔法数字（5、6、1、2）含义不明确，缺乏注释说明
没有持仓数量检查，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
cons_en: Depends on custom indicator ColorSchaffRVITrendCycle which must be installed separately and is not in the standard library, increasing deployment complexity
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large and may be unsuitable for lower timeframes or highly volatile instruments
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, potentially leading to unfavorable fills during low-liquidity or high-spread periods
Magic numbers in color buffer thresholds (5, 6, 1, 2) are unclear with no explanatory comments
No position count check, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在高点差和低流动性时段交易
添加持仓检查逻辑，防止同方向重复开仓，并可考虑加入最大持仓数限制
将指标颜色缓冲区的硬编码阈值替换为可配置参数，增加策略适应性
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session controls to avoid trading during high-spread and low-liquidity periods
Add position checking logic to prevent duplicate same-direction entries, and consider implementing a maximum position count limit
Replace hardcoded color buffer threshold magic numbers with configurable input parameters to improve strategy adaptability

risk_points: 缺少持仓数量检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致过度敞口
没有点差过滤和交易时段控制，可能在不利市场条件下成交
依赖外部自定义指标，若指标文件缺失或版本不匹配将导致初始化失败
risk_points_en: No position count check may lead to duplicate same-direction entries causing excessive exposure
No spread filter or session control may result in trades during unfavorable market conditions
Dependency on external custom indicator means initialization failure if indicator file is missing or version-mismatched
